_doc: Audio mix (0.107, src/audio/): clip trims (gainDb) bring every sound effect to an intended loudness (measuredDb = the file's loudest 50ms, measured in 0.107; measuredDb + gainDb = hits sit around -12 dB, rare finds and stingers louder, the click subtle). Buses: music and effects -> master -> limiter (a safety net: louder rare finds, sliders, stacked hits). sfxLevel 0.7 keeps the overall level where 0.106 was. voices: at most maxPerClip copies of one clip and maxTotal overall, repeats within retriggerMs dropped, each copy already sounding lowers the next by stackDb. pan.width = how far left/right sounds sit (0 = mono, 1 = hard). duck = the music dips by db under these stingers for the given seconds. volumes = default slider positions (0-1; players' own settings persist in localStorage). music.tracks (0.114; one score since 0.118) = per scene the generated bed: an exact loop of loopS seconds with its first tailS seconds appended (the restart crossfade), gainDb its level trim (set in 0.114 to match the old beds as played, in Chromium). 0.108: victory (the 'You escaped!' fanfare) 30% quieter (-3.1 dB); whoosh = the generated room-to-room sound (audio/synth.js), measured from an offline render. 0.110: variation = per-hit variety for the strikes: a random pitch (rate), a random tone colour (a peaking EQ between eq.lo and eq.hi Hz, +/- eq.db) and random articulation layers generated in audio/synth.js (tick = blade glint, thud = body, slice = the swing's air, clank = armour), each joining with probability p at db (layer trims put them 6-12 dB under the hit: tick raw -17.1, thud -11.7, slice -23.5, clank -13.9 dB). loot (the coin jingle) 3 dB quieter. 0.118: clips is the one sound registry — per name a file (or synth: generated by audio/synth.js, trim 0 = the caller sets the level), gainDb, stinger (never cut off for another sound), rate [lo, hi] + jitterDb (random pitch / level per play; a variation config below overrides the pitch).
